features.name: log_weighted_fp_score
features.description: Log-transformed weighted fingerprinting score to smooth extreme values and provide a continuous severity measure suitable for linear margins.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces the impact of extreme outliers in fingerprinting scores, allowing the linear model to learn a more robust weight.

features.name: cookie_prevalence_ratio
features.description: Ratio of cookie prevalence to overall prevalence, indicating the proportion of an entity's presence that involves stateful tracking.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized measure of reliance on cookies relative to overall reach, which is highly discriminative for linear boundaries.

features.name: script_to_resource_ratio
features.description: The proportion of resources that are scripts, highlighting domains that primarily serve executable code rather than passive media.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes script counts against total resources, creating a bounded ratio that linearly separates code-heavy domains from content-heavy ones.

features.name: log_max_cookie_ttl_days
features.description: Log-transformed maximum cookie time-to-live in days, capturing the intended duration of stateful tracking.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses the massive range of cookie expirations into a smooth, continuous feature that correlates with long-term tracking intent.

features.name: api_diversity_score
features.description: Normalized count of distinct APIs used, representing the breadth of browser capabilities accessed.
features.expected_model_benefit: Scales the distinct API count to a standard [0,1] range, preventing it from dominating other features in the SVM margin calculation.

features.name: fingerprinting_severity
features.description: Normalized maximum of domain-level and resource-level fingerprinting scores.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines two categorical/ordinal fingerprinting indicators into a single continuous severity metric.

features.name: privacy_transparency_deficit
features.description: Binary indicator of whether the domain lacks either an identified owner or a privacy policy.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a clear, linearly separable flag for domains that operate opaquely, which strongly correlates with certain tracking behaviors.

features.name: invasive_api_composite
features.description: Bounded composite score of highly invasive API categories (canvas, audio, webrtc).
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates sparse counts of specific fingerprinting vectors into a dense, bounded feature that directly contributes to the SVM decision boundary.

features.name: log_total_api_calls
features.description: Log-transformed total volume of API calls made by the domain's scripts.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooths the highly skewed distribution of API call volumes, allowing the model to learn from magnitude without being overly sensitive to extreme outliers.

features.name: cname_cloaking_risk
features.description: Interaction feature combining the presence of CNAME records with a normalized count of subdomains.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the specific pattern of CNAME cloaking by activating only when CNAMEs are present and scaling with subdomain proliferation.

features.name: storage_and_cookie_intensity
features.description: Bounded composite score combining storage API usage, first-party cookies, and cookies sent.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a unified metric for stateful tracking mechanisms, providing a strong linear signal for domains that heavily utilize client-side storage.

features.name: semantic_tracker_profile
features.description: A holistic assessment of the domain's tracking profile, evaluating the combination of high API diversity, long cookie TTLs, lack of privacy policy, and high fingerprinting scores to determine overall tracking likelihood.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures complex, non-linear interactions between transparency, statefulness, and fingerprinting that are difficult to express in a single formula, providing a high-level summary for the linear model.
